cases.name: type1_threshold
cases.source: Sagan 1973 Kardashev rung formula K=(log10(P_W)-6)/10; 1e16 W is the canonical Type I (planetary) threshold, giving exactly K=1.0

cases.name: type2_threshold
cases.source: Sagan 1973 formula; 1e26 W approximates solar luminosity scale (Lsun=3.828e26 W), giving K=2.0 at the Type II boundary

cases.name: earth_2024_energy_use
cases.source: 580 EJ/yr (Earth 2024 primary energy use, per tool default) converted to average watts = 580e18 J / 3.1557e7 s/yr, then Sagan formula independently applied
